metadata.title: Evidence archive for Adaptive Wavelet-Band Self-Blending and Multi-Prototype Contrastive Regularization
metadata.description:
Versioned evidence archive supporting the article “Adaptive Wavelet-Band Self-Blending and Multi-Prototype Contrastive Regularization for Cross-Dataset Generalization of Deepfake Detection”.

The archive provides configurations, source-code snapshots, prediction artifacts, evaluation scripts, calibration analyses, experiment passports, integrity manifests, and reproducibility documentation for the second WISER article.

Version 1.0.5 excludes experiment E07 from the evidence scheme of the second article. E07 concerns disabling the CND architectural component of WISER and requires a separate model retraining; therefore, it is retained only as a protocol for a future architectural study and is not used to support claims about AWB-SBI or RP-MPHC.

The executable spectral-analysis pipeline for comparing Real, Fake-FF++, Fake-Celeb-DF++, SBI, and AWB-SBI groups was verified end-to-end using a synthetic self-test. The synthetic values are not published or used as scientific evidence. The scientific spectral comparison has not been completed because licensed FaceForensics++ and Celeb-DF++ frames are not distributed with the archive.

The archive includes the completed E08r post-training comparison, in which calibrated and uncalibrated predictions are evaluated using the same raw E04 logits and the same frame-to-video aggregation rule.

FaceForensics++ and Celeb-DF++ datasets are not redistributed because they are governed by their respective access conditions. See README.md, CLAIM_LEDGER.md, REPRODUCIBILITY.md, LICENSE.md, and LICENSES/README.md for evidence boundaries, reproducibility instructions, and file-level licensing.

metadata.title: Evidence archive for Adaptive Wavelet-Band Self-Blending and Multi-Prototype Contrastive Regularization
metadata.description:
This versioned evidence archive supports the article “Adaptive Wavelet-Band Self-Blending and Multi-Prototype Contrastive Regularization for Improving Cross-Dataset Generalization of a Deepfake Detector”.

Version 1.0.4 adds the controlled post-hoc experiment E08r. The uncalibrated and calibrated branches are computed from the same raw E04 logits, labels and video identifiers, using identical arithmetic-mean video pooling. The published calibrator is applied without refitting.

On Celeb-DF++, calibration changed video-level AUC from 0.689434 to 0.674341, balanced accuracy from 0.575738 to 0.563569, Brier score from 0.095755 to 0.192059, and ECE from 0.221576 to 0.361667. Thus, after controlling the frame-aggregation rule, the published post-processing procedure does not improve external probability metrics and reduces video-level AUC.

The archive contains the E08r passport, executable evaluation script, metrics, fixed-bin calibration curves, run metadata, source-logit checksums, experiment configurations, source and execution snapshots, reproducibility instructions, licensing information and a SHA-256 manifest.

E04 remains a single partially documented training run. E05–E07 have not been numerically completed, the original E08 comparison is confounded by simultaneous changes in training duration and post-processing, and E09 requires factorization. E08r supports conclusions only about post-hoc processing of the fixed E04 logits and does not establish the causal contribution of AWB-SBI or RP-MPHC.

FaceForensics++ and Celeb-DF++ source datasets are not redistributed because they are subject to their own access conditions.

metadata.title: Evidence Archive for Adaptive Wavelet-Band Self-Blending and Multi-Prototype Contrastive Regularization in Cross-Dataset Deepfake Detection
metadata.description:
This record contains version 1.0.0 of the evidence archive prepared for the study “Adaptive Wavelet-Band Self-Blending and Multi-Prototype Contrastive Regularization for Improving Cross-Dataset Generalization of a Deepfake Detector”.

The archive documents the WISER experimental configurations E04–E09 and separates directly available run evidence from configuration-only and protocol-only materials. Experiment E04 includes the resolved configuration, metrics, an EMA checkpoint, calibration metadata, run metadata, and a snapshot of the relevant source code. Only one training seed is available for E04. The execution metadata does not independently attest the source commit because the recorded git SHA is unknown.

E05 and E06 are represented by audited configurations and experiment passports. E05 preserves MPHC and disables only the realism-preserving RP term. E06 replaces AWB-SBI with standard spatial self-blending while retaining SBI. E08 is identified as a non-isolating calibration ablation because it also changes the training schedule from 100 to 60 epochs. E09 is documented as a composite prediction-adaptive AWB-SBI v2 configuration whose controller is updated without gradients.

The package contains experiment passports, upstream configuration snapshots, an evidence claim ledger, completeness requirements, corrective protocols, a WISER source snapshot, an E04 checkpoint, SHA-256 manifests, and an autonomous archive validator. Missing checkpoints, predictions, training logs, split manifests, and repeated seeds are explicitly declared and are not replaced by inferred or fabricated values.

FaceForensics++ and Celeb-DF++ are not redistributed in this archive. Users must obtain these datasets independently and comply with their original access and licensing conditions.

Archive integrity can be checked after extraction with:

python3 tools/validate_archive.py

The strict completeness check is:

python3 tools/validate_archive.py --require-complete

The strict check intentionally reports an incomplete evidence set until the missing runs, predictions, and additional seeds are added in a future version.

SHA-256 of the deposited ZIP file: d6393b64a9b26defcffd82321417035e92cdc72756a8a2330cd7eca76d91a976.
